assertion: The oversized yellow child is clipped to rounded corners and multiplied with the aqua parent inside an isolated group: lime inside, aqua in the corners, white outside the parent.

browser.reason: Multiply requires aqua times yellow to produce lime. All browsers agree on the boxes, solid colors and clipping. Chrome differs from Valle at 64 curved-edge pixels by one channel level. Firefox (225 pixels, max 31) and WebKit (213, max 17) use different edge coverage.
